_doc: IT endpoints used by the in-world UI (AAS inspector, operator terminal) and the menu link to the Grafana dashboard. The inspector opens assets by global asset id via discovery + registry (ADR-0023): aas_registries lists the environments [{name, discovery, aas_registry, submodel_registry}] in lookup order (empty = all at aas_url, which is also the fallback repository and the concept description source): the plant's (8091) and the suppliers' (8191, batch AAS of the as-built BoM, ADR-0028). resolver_url: GS1 Digital Link resolver (inspector action 'Scan QR' of workpieces); alarms_url: alarms service (HMI acknowledge button); product_gtin: GTIN of the produced cylinder. Override with --vf-aas-url / --vf-resolver-url / --vf-bpmn-url / --vf-grafana-url / --vf-alarms-url.
